rule: the smoke run measures s_upd (mean wall seconds per update over updates 3..20) and s_cal (wall seconds of one calibration pass); projected_train = U*s_upd + (U/100 + 1)*s_cal; projected_eval = 3 * s_cal * (N_test * (128 + 1024 + 576) + 3 * N_test * 128) / (N_cal * 128); with margin 300 s, U = 2000 if smoke_wall + projected_train + projected_eval + 300 <= 3600 and the analogous CPU projection (measured process_time scaled the same way) + 600 <= 7200; otherwise U = the largest multiple of 100 that satisfies both; if U < 500 the run is INCOMPLETE_BUDGET and test is not opened. The decision is written by the smoke stage and read by the train stage; it is not changed after seeing any performance
